overview: Newquay Zoo is a compact, manageable zoo tucked into 13 acres of subtropical gardens in Trenance Leisure Park, about ten minutes’ walk from Newquay station. It opened in 1969 and is the biggest zoo in Cornwall, with several hundred animals from dozens of species, including some of the rarest small carnivores in the world.

It’s a comfortable size for little legs: most families spend two to three hours here, wandering between enclosures and planting, catching a keeper talk or two and letting the children loose in the play areas. A few indoor animal houses give you somewhere to duck into if a shower blows through.

expect.title: The animals
expect.text: Penguins, red pandas, monkeys, tropical birds and reptiles, plus less familiar threatened species and new arrivals as the zoo develops.

expect.title: Indoor houses
expect.text: Gems of the Jungle is a walk-through space with free-flying tropical birds, and the Tropical House is a warm place to thaw out on a cold day.

expect.title: Talks and feeds
expect.text: Keeper talks and feeding times run throughout the day and are included in your ticket, as are the play areas.

goodToKnow.label: Opening
goodToKnow.text: Open every day from 10am, all year round. Closing time changes with the season, and last entry is an hour before.

goodToKnow.label: Tickets
goodToKnow.text: Entry is paid. Online tickets are 15% cheaper as long as you buy them by 10am on the day you go. There are no set family tickets, so you choose adult and child tickets individually. Annual memberships include joint ones with Paignton Zoo.

goodToKnow.label: Food
goodToKnow.text: Café Lemur and two seasonal outlets sell meals, snacks and ice cream, and picnics are welcome. Guard your sandwiches: the gulls are bold.

goodToKnow.label: Getting there
goodToKnow.text: It’s in Trenance Leisure Park, near the town centre and a short walk from the station.

entry.note: Paid entry; tickets online or at the gate

week.text: The zoo is an easy half day if you’re staying in or near Newquay, and a good fallback when the surf’s flat or the weather’s iffy. Pair it with a run-around in Trenance Gardens next door or an afternoon on one of the town beaches.

pairWith.why: gardens and a boating lake right next door
an indoor aquarium if it turns wet

tips: Buy tickets online before 10am on the day for the discount.
Go first thing for the most active animals and an easier time parking.
